title: GeekGear Alternatives: 5 Harry Potter Boxes - Cratejoy
summary: Compare five Harry Potter boxes like GeekGear’s Wizardry box, from a licensed crate with a T-shirt to house-matched and fan-made picks.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Monthly, from a UK seller


### Potter Crate vs GeekGear


1st box


10% off


[Potter Crate | Harry Potter Mystery Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/potter-crate-harry-potter-mystery-box-smugglerscrate) by Smugglers Crate


From $41.88 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/potter-crate-harry-potter-mystery-box-smugglerscrate)


**Best for:** The GeekGear fan whose favorite part is a monthly surprise of Potter merch.


Smugglers Crate fills Potter Crate with memorabilia, artwork, and accessories from the Potterverse, and you pick how much: 5 to 7 items in the Standard Crate, 6 to 10 in the Premium, or 10 to 15 in the Collector’s Edition.


#### What feels familiar


A monthly Harry Potter mystery box, packed and shipped in the UK, like GeekGear’s.


#### What changes


The listing doesn’t promise a T-shirt, a print, or anything matched to your house, so expect a wider mix of fan merch.


Officially licensed, with a T-shirt


### Loot Crate Wizarding World vs GeekGear


**Best for:** The fan who wants licensed collectibles and doesn’t mind two months between boxes.


[Loot Crate](https://lootcrate.com/products/wizarding-world) ’s Wizarding World crate holds four to six officially licensed Harry Potter and Fantastic Beasts pieces, from collectibles and figures to apparel.


#### What feels familiar


You choose a T-shirt size when you join, and the crate pairs wearables with collectibles, the same mix at the center of GeekGear’s box.


#### What changes


Six crates a year instead of twelve, and nothing is matched to your house. To catch the next crate, order by the 3rd of an odd-numbered month.


Matched to your house


### Bibbidi Wizard vs GeekGear


**Best for:** The Ravenclaw who wants a box in their own house colors every month.


[Bibbidi](https://bibbidiboxes.com/products/bibbidi-wizard) ’s Wizard box asks for your house mascot (lion, eagle, snake, badger, or not sorted yet), your shirt size, and how much you want to spend. At some price points you can go fully customized and fill in a preference manager and wishlist that guide what gets packed.


#### What feels familiar


A monthly box built around your house, the part of GeekGear the other boxes here leave out.


#### What changes


Each price tier promises items worth at least what you pay. Boxes mix licensed merchandise with small-shop finds, and Bibbidi says it isn’t affiliated with Warner Bros.


Fan-made replicas and potions


### The Wizarding Trunk vs GeekGear


**Best for:** The collector who keeps GeekGear’s prints and props on a shelf.


[The Wizarding Trunk](https://thewizardingtrunk.com/) is a US company whose boxes lean toward things you display. Potion bottles are handcrafted for it by Pure Blood Apothecary, and fan artists design its paper replicas, book covers, and wearables. Each box has a theme, such as Year 7 or Cozy Wizarding Winter.


#### What feels familiar


Replicas and prints made for display, like the art print in every GeekGear box.


#### What changes


Boxes come every other month (7 to 10 items) or quarterly as a bigger Special Edition (9 to 12 items), and both sell out. When one does, the site lists the date the next one opens. Renewals bill on fixed dates, and subscriptions aren’t refunded.


One box as a gift


### Wizarding Worlds Amazing Mystery Box vs GeekGear


[Wizarding Worlds Amazing Mystery Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/wizarding-worlds-amazing-mystery-box) by The Amazing Mystery Box


$33.76


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/wizarding-worlds-amazing-mystery-box)


**Best for:** The gifter who wants one wizarding box for a birthday, with no subscription.


This is a one-off box from The Amazing Mystery Box: eight officially licensed Harry Potter items picked as a surprise, with no subscription to cancel afterward.


#### What feels familiar


A box of wizarding surprises packed in the UK, like GeekGear’s.


#### What changes


It’s one box, not a monthly plan. Order before the 18th to make that month’s batch.
